policy: The old lane was treated as a candidate index. Old accepted and excluded candidates were re-screened with the same relevance, authority, coverage, and claim-value criteria used for new candidates.

dispositions.title: DropoutNet: Addressing Cold Start in Recommender Systems
dispositions.reason: Direct, authoritative item-side zero-interaction definition, dropout mechanism, and cohort-construction evidence; full official artifact inspected.

dispositions.title: How to Learn Item Representation for Cold-Start Multimedia Recommendation?
dispositions.reason: Direct item-representation cold-start method with complementary multimedia coverage; retained as a planning candidate while full-content acquisition remains queued.

dispositions.title: Contrastive Learning for Cold-Start Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Direct contrastive cold-start method complementary to distillation and transfer sources; retained only as metadata-verified candidate pending original-content locator.

dispositions.title: Aligning Distillation For Cold-start Item Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Direct item-side zero-edge formulation, separate warm/cold evaluation tasks, and warm-to-cold distillation evidence; full author artifact inspected.

dispositions.title: Towards Universal Sequence Representation Learning for Recommender Systems
dispositions.reason: Audit-core transferable sequential-recommendation source with explicit target-domain adaptation and inductive/transductive distinctions; full artifact inspected.

dispositions.title: Learning Vector-Quantized Item Representation for Transferable Sequential Recommenders
dispositions.reason: Required vector-quantized transfer source with explicit content-to-code pipeline and multi-domain adaptation evidence; full artifact inspected.

dispositions.title: Language Representations Can Be What Recommenders Need: Findings and Potentials
dispositions.reason: Audit-core recommender evidence that separates language representation from the projection, graph, and recommendation objective; zero-shot source/target lineage can be inspected directly.

dispositions.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
dispositions.reason: Audit-core encoder-rationale boundary source; retained precisely because its inspected content supports sentence embedding construction but not recommendation efficacy.

dispositions.title: Cold-start Recommendation by Personalized Embedding Region Elicitation
dispositions.reason: Authoritative but exclusively user-side preference elicitation. It is not item-side cold-start evidence and the forbidden cold-user/cold-item equivalence is already encoded explicitly without retaining this record.

dispositions.title: Are Graph Augmentations Necessary?: Simple Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Retained as a collaborative-only sparse-graph control, not as zero-edge cold-item evidence; metadata verified and full-content acquisition remains queued.

dispositions.title: XSimGCL: Towards Extremely Simple Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Retained as a sparse collaborative control and direct SimGCL continuation; the 2024 issue year was verified separately from the 2023 online-first DOI metadata.

dispositions.title: LightGCL: Simple Yet Effective Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Retained as a distinct global/spectral collaborative graph control; explicitly forbidden as evidence for representing a zero-edge item.

dispositions.title: Improving Item Cold-start Recommendation via Model-agnostic Conditional Variational Autoencoder
dispositions.reason: Direct but lower incremental claim value than the retained zero-edge definition, distillation, bias, and 2026 content-objective sources; limited-interaction framing is not automatically the locked zero-edge cohort.

dispositions.title: Generative Adversarial Framework for Cold-Start Item Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Valid primary paper but redundant for the locked claims after retaining DropoutNet, ALDI, CGRC, and the inherited-bias counter-evidence; adds a compute-expanding adversarial branch without closing a coverage gap.

dispositions.title: Socially-aware Dual Contrastive Learning for Cold-Start Recommendation
dispositions.reason: Cold-user and social-graph method rather than item-side zero-edge evidence.

dispositions.title: LLaRA: Large Language-Recommendation Assistant
dispositions.reason: General LLM-recommendation architecture is not needed to establish the locked encoder-versus-recommender or strict item-cold boundaries and would expand compute and scope.

dispositions.title: Large Language Models meet Collaborative Filtering: An Efficient All-round LLM-based Recommender System
dispositions.reason: Broad LLM recommender, not direct strict cold-item or transfer-assumption evidence; adds scope and compute without closing a locked coverage gap.

dispositions.title: Amazon-M2: A Multilingual Multi-locale Shopping Session Dataset for Recommendation and Text Generation
dispositions.reason: Scholarly dataset paper belongs to dataset/external-validity lanes and does not provide cold-item method efficacy or transfer-assumption evidence for L4. It is not moved to the operational-resource registry because it is a scholarly work.

dispositions.title: ViHoRec: A Quality-Controlled Vietnamese Hotel Recommendation Dataset and Cold-Start Benchmark
dispositions.reason: Preprint, dataset-centered, and short-history user setting rather than peer-reviewed zero-edge item evidence; dataset assessment belongs to another lane.
